FIELDS.NAME: Blossom & Bloom Florist
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Blossom & Bloom Florist, we specialize in crafting beautiful floral arrangements for various occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and everyday celebrations. Our operations are centered around our retail store located in Springfield, IL, where we source high-quality flowers from reputable suppliers. We implement formal commercial contracts with clients to outline responsibilities and ensure smooth operations. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional customer service while maintaining meticulous safety protocols for floral handling and delivery. We conduct regular risk assessments and safety evaluations to continuously improve our services. Additionally, we have established processes for packaging and planning deliveries to minimize product loss and ensure customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on 02/10/2023 due to a delivery vehicle accident resulting in damage to product valued at $1,200. Status: Resolved. Losses occurred on 08/15/2023 from spoilage of flowers due to equipment failure, amounting to $1,300. Status: Under review.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated safe, Class B, UL listed for security and fire protection.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing secured around the premises, monitored by a professional security service during non-operating hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations primarily involve floral arrangements and retail sales without hazardous material handling.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on floral arrangements and related retail operations.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the operations manager to ensure compliance with our insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a commitment to ethical business practices in all our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed within the prior three years. Our insurance history remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed within our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Blossom & Bloom Florist carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with state regulations and to provide coverage for our employees. This policy is active and covers all eligible workers employed by our business.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not own or operate any other business. We focus solely on our floral arrangements and retail operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. They currently hold one policy as listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus entirely on crafting floral arrangements for retail sale.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations are focused solely on providing floral arrangements and retail services without engaging in equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on floral arrangements and retail sales without handling hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not have any known catastrophe exposure. Our operations are primarily retail-based and do not involve activities that would typically present such risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a commitment to ethical practices and does not have any history of such claims.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Blossom & Bloom Florist does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. We ensure compliance with local fire safety regulations and conduct regular safety evaluations to maintain a safe operating environment.
